question_text: What administrative and delivery event records can a tenant export to its own SIEM, and in what format?
answer_text: Tenant administrators can export three event streams: administrative actions in the tenant plane, message delivery and disposition events, and recipient authentication events. Records are emitted as newline-delimited JSON conforming to a published schema, and can be pulled from a per-tenant export endpoint or pushed to a customer-owned object store bucket on a five-minute cadence. Field-level documentation and a mapping to the Elastic Common Schema are supplied so the stream can be onboarded into a customer SIEM without bespoke parsing. Records are retained in the platform for 400 days independently of what the tenant exports.
